approved_scope.title: Close the lessons loop: surface what a module already learned at proposal, name where a lesson goes when a build fails, and assemble the archived bundle at finalize
approved_scope.description: Close the lessons loop: surface what a module already learned at proposal, name where a lesson goes when a build fails, and assemble the archived bundle at finalize
acceptance_criteria: a FAILED change check names where the lesson goes, including for a bare check with no id; a passing check prints nothing
change new names each affected module context.md with its substantive line count, counting only authored prose and never a generated scaffold
finalize writes lesson-bundle.md into the archive durably and next_action names the fold-back targets before the merge
frontmatter stripping has one definition matching view::strip_frontmatter, pinned by a discriminating multi-rule regression test
lessons policy lives in src/change.rs and the generator owns what a scaffold looks like; the command layer only renders
